It notes measurements followed national Brazilian Association of Technical Standards and that bra sizes ranged from 36 to 58. No study numbering, sample size, demographic, BMI, or body appreciation assessment data are provided in this section.
section_summary.evidence_source: Trained researchers measured participants' actual bra size, which may be a useful proxy for breast size in Brazil (Mendonc¸ a et al., 1999). Brazilian bra sizes do not take into account cup sizes, but rather takes into account the width of the back just below the back (i.e., band size). All measurements were made following the national reference benchmarks of the Brazilian Association of Technical Standards, with bra sizes ranging from 36 to 58.
